text:
lexa-design: quick sketch up in Figma -> https://figma.com/file/x/console-rail-reorg : reorganized left rail into three top-level zones (Models / Serving / Insights). want a quick sanity check on linking + breadcrumbs. thoughts? :eyes:
ajay-ux: i like the mental model. main question: what happens to deep links that target a nested panel (e.g. model detail with the ‘versions’ tab) — should the URL land on the nested route or expand the parent and then scroll?
sam-frontend: backend routing contract proposal (WIP):
```
/workspaces/:ws/models/:modelId
/workspaces/:ws/serve/instances/:instId
/workspaces/:ws/insights/latency
```
My preference is: canonical nested URL (so bookmarkable) and the client should open parent + focus first interactive element. preserve scroll/expanded state if query param `?open=versions` is present.
kelly-pm: copy / taxonomy nit: can we avoid using both "Models" and "Model registry" across screens? pick one. also breadcrumbs should read: Workspace > Models > my-model — not the route segments.
mike-a11y: a11y nits: screen readers need an announcement when we programmatically expand a section. propose: aria-live="polite" announce "Models section expanded, showing 4 items". also keyboard: left-rail items must be tabbable with clear focus ring; when deep-link opens a nested panel, focus should go to the panel heading and not the expanded container.
lexa-design: good call on focus. for copy let's pick "Models" everywhere (kelly, approved?). also i'm thinking of adding a small chevron + aria-expanded on the group headers so AT can detect state.
ajay-ux: chevron + aria-expanded works. one more thing: back-button behaviour — if user navigates from Models list -> model detail (client-side nav), back should restore list scroll pos. that's been flaky in older versions. we should add a history state with scrollY.
sam-frontend: agreed. implementation sketch: pushState({scroll: window.scrollY, open: 'versions'}) on navigate; on popstate, read state and restore. simple but we need tests for SSR and when a link hits directly (no history).
kelly-pm: can we have permalink badges on model rows (small link icon) so PMs can copy direct links? will reduce support asks.
mike-a11y: permalink icon should have aria-label="Copy link to model" and be keyboard-accessible. also ensure the color contrast of the icon hit target meets 4.5:1 or add a 24px focus area.
routebot: route-lint-bot: Found 2 failing specs -> back-button restore tests failing on /workspaces/:ws/models flow. See CI #4532.
lexa-design: ok, plan coming out of this thread: 1) sam to add history-state PR + unit tests. 2) mike to author the a11y acceptance criteria (announce + focus rules). 3) design to update Figma copy to "Models" and add chevron/expanded states. 4) eng infra to triage CI failures. I'll create GH issues and link here. thanks! :party_parrot:
